title: Bump the shipped ComfyUI engine v0.31.0 -> v0.34.0
description: Bench (G:/ComfyUi) went v0.31.0 -> v0.34.2 clean on 2026-08-28: zero import failures, 2052 node types, and 11 of the 17 shipped node pins sit at the exact pinned commit, so they are already proven. Move dev_configs/node_lock.json off v0.31.0 via /mpi-bump-engine. Target v0.34.0 - it is the newest PUBLISHED GitHub Release; v0.34.1/.2 are tags with no release object and add only cloud partner nodes plus an HEVC remux fix. Two risks carried in brief.md: av >=16 -> >=17 is a PyAV major bump that must hold inside the Pod image and portable engine (smoke a VIDEO op), and comfyui-workflow-templates is now a meta-package pulling seven subpackages while node_lock pins only the parent.
